core1b.fresh_task: A student says every transparent slab returns an emergent ray parallel to its incident ray even if air is on one side and water on the other. Justify or reject.
core1b.protected_work: Demonstrate the condition for parallel emergence and expose an exception.

stages.predict: State your expected result, direction or relationship before solving. Record uncertainty if needed.
stages.attempt: A student says every transparent slab returns an emergent ray parallel to its incident ray even if air is on one side and water on the other. Justify or reject.
stages.reconstruct: Combining n_left sin i=n_slab sin r=n_right sin e; if n_left≠n_right, e generally differs from i (except normal incidence). Parallel faces alone insufficient.
stages.diagnose: Only if your saved answer demonstrates this error: Assuming parallel faces alone guarantee equal external direction. Otherwise record insufficient evidence; compare your actual reasoning with the reconstruction.
stages.repair: Eliminate internal sine and check outside indices and face normals.
stages.boundary_test: What if total internal reflection prevents emergence?
